levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة

notes: two branches joined by «ح», each writing its own names through to Ibn Abbas: null tail (rule 3)
the second branch is the same saying in fuller wording («قال أبو داود وهذا لفظ القعنبي وهو أتم»), so a group, not a variant (rule 4)
«قال مالك وأنا أرى ذلك واسعا» is Malik's own remark, not a link
